# Third-party license bundle staging area

This directory is intentionally incomplete for the sealed AgentGuard RC.
It contains no fabricated license text. The exact files and deterministic
planned locations are listed in `artifacts/license-source-bundle-plan.json`.

Before distribution, assemble authoritative exact-version LICENSE, COPYING,
NOTICE, copyright, AUTHORS, and applicable source artifacts from the recorded
official upstream, Debian, or CentOS sources. A URL alone is not treated as a
completed bundle. Preserve exact upstream wording and retain file-scoped
attributions; do not infer or rewrite legal terms.
